evidence.description: Sorted actual spec paths and hashes

semantic_fidelity.reason: All 17 components and 23 directions are present, but audit / verify omits reimage, run audit drops machine-audit identity, pull image omits boot; v3 cluster state clipped and boot sits above machines rather than subsequent down-page phase.

arrow_traceability.reason: All 23 distinct stems reach correctly directed heads. The v4 S3 detour avoids webapi and its box, no crossing or fake junction; both boot directions independently visible.

layout_fit.reason: Each final-spec pinned dump supplies the 77x47 natural viewport, but cluster state is clipped to cluster stat in v3 at the right margin; 82x51 shows it complete.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Related logical source roles share pink, purple, teal and orange families; humans and state reuse teal but occur in separate views, so no within-view collision. No group boxes; v4 pins honor meaningful ops grouping, not lifecycle phase encoding.

border_integrity.reason: Inspected every complete four-sided box and corner in normal and select-all ANSI; each border uniform RGB and no palette overlap. 25/25 simultaneous select-all occurrences, not individual selection sequences.

workflow_evidence.reason: Frozen inputs, identities, 103 paired raw command hashes, four successful recorded validators, pane dimensions and cleanup recorded. Target-size dumps have 52/52/78/90 frames, but v1 two dots demonstrably never complete a lap, so an actual full-lap animation capture for every route is unavailable; no independent new session was run.

animation.reason: Every pinned frame contains one dot per route, but v1 entry dots oscillate at (29,18)/(29,19) and (48,18)/(48,19), never traversing; check falsely asserts constant speed. The full timestamp evidence cannot prove all route laps.

category_fit.reason: Correct dominant lifecycle-machines family and source-backed line; queue has five destinations across views and separate labelled boot request and response are co-viewed. Recipe is not fully applied: v2 boot is above machines so request goes up, and no single top-to-bottom provisioning→boot→heartbeat→reconcile phase sequence exists across views; two live transitions do not traverse. No measured impossibility/yield in generation.json addresses the phase order.
category_fit.generator_evidence_line: one queue fans to five phase destinations (provider registry, SSH ops, S3, janitor, Postgres) and the source gives an ordered machine life - provisioning -> boot -> heartbeat -> reconcile - with every transition live, which the human's last correction renders as exactly one dot per line.
category_fit.secondary_recipe: service-meshes' anti-parallel rule applied to machines <-> boot server (iPXE request and boot.ipxe + S3 args response): both directions are drawn in v2 as two separate edges with distinct labels and ports, never merged into one bidirectional arrow
verified_recipe_facts: two labelled anti-parallel boot links in v2
v2 boot above machines, iPXE arrow points up
v3 heartbeat and reconcile placed in separate view without full phase order
two v1 routes do not traverse

findings.description: Defect: pinned frames 0/4/20 show dots at (29,18),(48,18); 2/10/30/51 at (29,19),(48,19). They cycle backwards and never reach their arrows; check reports zero violations and constant speed incorrectly.
Defect: v3 77x47 shows cluster stat, omitting the last e of cluster state; larger live pane is not the pinned fit gate.

Defect: audit / verify drops reimage, run audit loses the machine-audit identifier, and pull image drops boot qualifier; none appears elsewhere in v4. All are slotted, but no recorded evidence demonstrates complete wording impossible.

Defect: in v2 boot server is in the providers rank above machines, with iPXE travelling upward, so source provisioning to boot is not top-down. Cross-view ordering does not show a single boot→heartbeat→reconcile rank sequence; no evidenced structural-impossibility yield addresses this.

Evidence gap: 77x47 pinned frame files span nominal full-lap budgets, but two v1 dots never complete their routes; live pane frames retain only a subset. A full actual lap for every route is not established.

blockers: Full-lap target-size evidence for v1 entry routes is unavailable because the captured renderer oscillates; correcting and recapturing requires a renderer change or a different layout and a new run.
Generator reports one-sided label-slot gutter and no minlen; neither is demonstrated to make phase order impossible.
Pane recent scrollback retained only a subset of requested frames; pinned direct dumps supply target-size frame sequences but do not cure the oscillation.
